svg.title: Similarity matrix for one batch
svg.desc: Six images against six captions: the diagonal holds matched pairs (0.84 to 0.93) and off-diagonal mismatches are low.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The N × N similarity matrix (N = 6): maximize the diagonal
